messages:
Jordan (release-manager): Quick heads-up — we need a minimal hotpatch for the kvcache edge case. Planning to bump 1.13.4 -> 1.13.5, only the security/kvcache fix and the tiny timeout tweak. Cutting an expedited freeze at 22:00 PT today unless major blockers show up. PR: https://git.redwood/models/pulls/1234 :eyes:
Priya: ACK. I'll take primary review and run the smoke suite.
Samira: What do you want in the changelog? security-only or bugfix with a CVE placeholder?
Jordan (release-manager): Mark as security with a short blurb and CVE TBD. Keep wording minimal: "Fix token-prefetch kvcache race leading to occasional OOMs".
Felix: I opened the cherry-pick branch `release/1.13.5-minimal` and pushed PR #1234. Link above. Please avoid other commits on that branch.
deploy-bot: staging deploy started for release/1.13.5-minimal @ 2050012352
Priya: Running full smoke now. If anything fails I'll paste logs here.
qa-runner: Quick note from QA: regression harness flagged a flaky timeout in the personalization path — probably unrelated but worth eyeballing.
Priya: Found one failing test in streaming: tail logs:
```
ERROR: kv_cache.cc:142 KVCache::fetch_prefix: timeout after 10s
WARN: model_server: stream aborted by client
```
This looks tied to the timeout tweak Felix added — investigating.
Felix: Hmm, that tweak should be safe. I can revert it from the branch if it's causing instability; prefer to keep only the security commit.
Samira: Reverting the timeout tweak keeps the "minimal diffs" promise. If re-run passes, we can proceed.
Priya: Rebased branch onto main and removed the timeout tweak commit. Re-running smoke, so far green locally.
deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded for release/1.13.5-minimal @ 2050012380
Priya: Staging smoke green. Canary will go out in ~10m.
Jordan (release-manager): Final call: if canary checks are clean by 2050012400 I will cut the tag and hand off to release engineer for prod rollout. Please add your changelog line and ping me when done.
Felix: Added changelog blurb in PR description and pinged @docs. Tag command I'll use after Jordan gives the go: `git tag -a v1.13.5 -m "hotfix: kvcache race (security)" && git push origin v1.13.5`
Samira: Canary metrics look good (error rate unchanged, p50/p95 latency stable). :thumbsup:
Priya: Verified canary, smoke and regression harness — all green.
Jordan (release-manager): Going to cut the release now. Tagging and initiating prod rollout. Thanks for the fast turn-around everyone. I'll post a short release note once rollout finishes.
deploy-bot: prod rollout started for v1.13.5 @ 2050012405
deploy-bot: prod rollout succeeded for v1.13.5 @ 2050012410
Jordan (release-manager): Release complete. Changelog: "Fix token-prefetch kvcache race leading to occasional OOMs (security hotfix)." CVE TBA. If you see any post-deploy anomalies please ping #eng-oncall. :rocket:
